complete_examples.overview: Complete workflow examples demonstrating the autoresearch mode in action. Each example shows the full cycle from request to results.

example.name: baseline_research_session
example.scenario: User wants to run an overnight autonomous research session to improve the val_bpb of a small LLM training setup.
example.user_request: Run an overnight research session to improve val_bpb on our current training setup.

step.approach: Check GPU availability, verify dependencies, run baseline training.

step.description: Initialize research branch and results tracking
step.approach: Create branch autoresearch/mar24, initialize results.tsv with header.
Generate hypothesis, modify train.py, commit, run, evaluate, log. Repeat for requested number of experiments.

experiment.hypothesis: Increasing learning rate from 0.03 to 0.04 will improve convergence
GeLU activation will provide better gradients than GELU-approx
experiment.change: Switch to exact GeLU in train.py

experiment.hypothesis: Double model width will increase capacity

step.approach: Review results.tsv, identify best configuration, document patterns.

example.completion: Research session completed: 100 experiments run, best val_bpb improved from 0.9979 to 0.9891 (0.86% improvement). Key finding: learning rate tuning provided the most consistent improvements.

key_takeaways.takeaway: Learning rate changes provide the most reliable improvements
Architecture changes carry higher risk of OOM crashes

example.name: small_gpu_research
example.scenario: User has a MacBook with limited GPU memory and wants to run research with adjusted parameters.
example.user_request: I have a MacBook with limited GPU memory. Can I still run autoresearch?

step.approach: Apply small GPU tuning: reduce vocab_size, MAX_SEQ_LEN, DEPTH, WINDOW_PATTERN, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE per the autoresearch skill guidelines.
Run train.py with adjusted parameters, confirm it completes within timeout.
Prioritize low-memory experiments first (LR tuning, weight decay). Avoid architecture changes that increase model size.

example.completion: Research completed on small GPU with adjusted parameters. Best val_bpb: 0.9856, up from baseline 0.9921.
